title: Vechidiki veMDC-T Voungana paHarvest House Vachichema Kushaya kwaVaTsvangirai
content:
Vechidiki vebato reMDC-T vatanga kuungana pamuzinda webato iri weHarvest House muHarare usiku huno vachichema kushaya kwemutungamiri webato ravo, VaMorgan Tsvangirai.

Mukuru wevechidiki mubato iri, VaHappymore Chidziva vanoti vane kurwadziva kukuru, zvikuru sevechidiki, nekushaya kwaVaTsvangirai uku. VaChidziva vanoti tarisiro yavo sevechidiki yakanga iri panaVaTsvangirai.

“Zvese zvakaitika munyika yeZimbabwe kusvika pano nhasi kuti vanhu titi kwakuitika mapato akasiyanasiyana, tinozviziva kuti zvaibva nekuda kwekutanga kwavakaita ivo bandiko ratakaita reMovement for Democratic Change. Saka tine kurwadziwa kwakanyanya nekurasikirwa nemutungamiri wedu,” VaChidziva vanodaro.

Mumwe wevechidiki vaungana paHarvest House, VaMorgan Ncube, avo vanoona nezvekurongwa kwemusangano muboka revechidiki vachibva kuMateleland South, vanotsinhirawo mashoko aVaChidziva ekuti varasikirwa aya, vachiti VaTsvangirai vakapa vana veZimbabwe chivindi chekurwisana nehurumende yevaive mutungamiri wenyika, VaRobert Mugabe.

“Tiri kuchema Baba VaTsvangirai. Baba vakarakidza vanhu veZimbabwe vakavapa chivindi chekurwisana [nevaive mutungamiri wenyika] naRobert Mugabe. Baba vakapa kuti vana veZimbabwe tive netariro yekuti munyika muno munogona kuvawo nemumwe mutungamiri asiri Mugabe. Tiri kuchema. Tiri kurwadziwa,” VaNcube vanodaro.

VaTsvangirai, vashayira kune chimwe chipatara chemuSouth Africa neChitatu uko vanga vachirapwa chirwere chegomarara change chavatambudza kwenguva yakareba.

Mutevedzeri waVaTsvangirai, VaElias Mudzuri, vatenda kuStudio7 kuti ichokwadi kuti mutungamiri webato ravo ashaya.

VaMudzuri ndivo vakanzi nemhuri yaVaTsvangirai vanotaura nezvehurwere hwaVaTsvangirai vakamirira bato.

Mashoko ekushaya kwaVaTsvangirai atsinhirwawo nehama yepedyo yaVaTsvangirai, iyo yati haikwanisi kutaura zvakawanda panguva ino.

VaMudzuri vati bato ravo rarasikirwa zvikuru nekushaya kwaVaTsvangirai

VaTsvangirai, avo vakamboita mutungamiri wehurumende munguva yehurumende yemubatanidzwa nebato reZanu PF, vashaya vave pedyo nekusvitsa makore makumi matanhatu nematanhatu ekuberekwa, uye vashaya panguva iyo mubato ravo muine makakatanwa ekuti ndiyani akafanobata chigaro chemutungamiri webato iri pakati paVaNelson Chamisa naVaElias Mudzuri.

MDC-T yanga yakatarisirwa kuita musangano wechimbi chimbi nemusi weChina muHarare wekuzeya makakatanwa ari mubato iri.

Zvichakadaro, mizinda yeAmerica neBritain muZimbabwe yaburitsa mashoko ekunyaradza zvichitevera kushaya kwaVaTsvangirai.

Mashoko aburitswa nemizinda iyi padandemutande reTwitter anoti inobatana nevana veZimbabwe munyika yose mukuchema kushaya kwemutungamiri wezvematongerwo enyika akanga asinganeti kurwira rusununguko pamwe nehutongo hwegutsa ruzhinji.

Muzinda weAmerica wati unoremekedza kurwira kwavo kuti mapato ose ezvematongerwo enyika abatwe zvakaenzana, uye kurwira kwavo kuti izwi remwana weZimbabwe wese rinzwikwe.
summary: Mukuru wevechidiki mubato iri, VaHappymore Chidziva vanoti vane kurwadziva kukuru, zvikuru sevechidiki, nekushaya kwaVaTsvangirai uku. VaChidziwa vanoti tarisiro yavo sevechidiki yakanga iri panaVaTsvangirai.

title: VaMphoko Voparura Chirongwa Chekupa Zvitupa Vakawirwa neDambudziko reGukurahundi
content:
Hurumende kuburikidza nemumwe mutevedzeri wemutungamiri wenyika, VaPhelekezela Mphoko, vanovazve gurukota rinoona nezvekupodzwa kwemaronda nekuregererana, yaparura chirongwa chekubatsira vanhu vakarasikirwa nevabereki munguva yeGukurahundi nedzimwe nyaya dzezvematongerwo enyika kuti vawane magwaro ekuberekwa pamwe nezvitupa.

VaMphoko vakaparura chirongwa ichi paTshino Primary School kuTsolothso nemusi weChipiri uye vakatiwo chichabatsira vakarasikirwa nemagwaro nyika yose nekuda kwemafashamu emvura mugore rino.

Asi vanopikisa vanoti Zanu-PF yave kuda kuita izvi panguva ino nechinangwa chekuda kutsvaga kuvhoterwa nevanhu kuMatabeleland muna 2018

Ongororo dzakaitwa nemasangano akawanda kusanganisira UNICEF dzinoratidza kuti vana vakawanda muZimbabwe, kunyanya kuMatabeleland, havana magwaro ekuzvarwa.

Ongororo yeUnicef iyi yakaitwa kuburikidza neZimbabwe Demographic Health Survey yakaratidza pachena kuti vana makumi mashanu nemumwe kubva muzana vainge vasina magwaro ekuberekwa nezvikonzero zvakasiyana siyana.

Mukuru wedzidzo kuMatabeleland South, Amai Thumisang Tabela, vanotiwo vana makumu matatu kubva muzana mudunhu ravo havana magwaro ekuzvarwa.

Vachiparura chirongwa ichi VaMphoko vakatiwo hurumende ichanovaka matombo pane vanhu vakavigwa vakawanda munguva yeGukurahundi kuTsolotsho, Lupane, Matabeleland South neMidlands. Vakati vanhu vemunzvimbo idzi havanawo magwaro ekuratidza kuti hama dzavo dzakaurayiwa munguva yeGukurahundi uye zvinonetsa kuti vawane zvitupa.

Mauto eFifth Brigade anonzi akauaraya vanhu muMidland neMatabelaland kubva muna 1983 kusvika 1987 mushure mekunetsana kunotyisa pakati peZapu nehurumende yeZanu-PF.

Vakafanobata chigaro chemutevedzeri wemutungamiri webato reNational People’s Party, VaSamuel Sipepa Nkomo, vanoti Zanu-PF iyo ine makore ichiramba kugadzirisa nyaya yeGukurahundi, yave kuda kubata vanhu kumeso.

title: MDC Inokunda Musarudzo yeWard 2, Kadoma Central
content:
MDC inotungamirwa naVaNelson Chamisa yakunda musarudzo yemu Ward 2 mudunhu reKadoma Central yakaitwa neMugovera.

Mashoko atatambira anoti Amai Shorayi Chiwara veMDC vanonzi vakawana mavhoti mazana manomwe nemakumi masere, ukuwo VaLloyd Nyasha Nyambo veZanu PF vakawana mavhoti mazana matatu nemakumi matanhatu nerimwe.

Sarudzo iyi iri yaitwa zvichitevera kuwanikwa nemhosva kwakaitwa VaMichael Gore veMDC avo vatongerwa kugara mujeri kwemakore matatu mushure mekupomerwa mhosva yekukurudzira mhirizhonga pakuratidzira kwakaitwa muna Ndira gore rino.

VaGore vari kupikisa mutongo uyu, uye havasi mujeri.

Studio7 haina kukwanisa kunzwa divi reZimbabwe Electoral Commission panyaya yezvabuda musarudzo yakanzura weWard 2 muKadoma Central.

Sangano rinoona nezvesarudzo rakazvimirira, reZimbabwe Election Support Network, kana kuti ZESN, rinoti harisi kufara kuti vanhu vanga vachimiswa kwenguva yakareba kuti vavhote asi vachizoudzwa vapinda mukati kuti mazita avo haapo panzvimbo yekuvhotera iyi.

Mukuru wezvirongwa muZESN, Amai Ellen Dingani, vaudza Studio7 kuti chichemo ichi vakachisvitsa ku Zimbabwe Electoral Commission asi hachisati chagadziriswa.

title: MDC-T Yoenderera neMisangano kuMashonaland West
content:
Bato reMDC inotungamirirwa naVaMorgan Tsvangirai rinoti richaenderera mberi nekuita misangano yaro mudunhu reMashonaland West risingateveri kurudziro yemapurisa yekuti ritange rawana mvumo kubva kumadzishe, masabhuku pamwe nemakanzuru enzvimbo dzinenge dzichiitirwa misangano iyi.

Munyori anoona nezvekurongwa kwemisangano mubato iri, VaNelson Chamisa, vanoti danho riri kuda kutorwa nemapurisa iri rakamboedzwa nehurumende yaIan Smith munguva yehondo yeChimurenga asi yakakundikana kumisa shanduko.

VaChamisa vanoti vanozviziva kuti mapurisa ari kushandiswa nevamwe vari kuda kuona bato reMDC richibhaniwa mudunhu iri.

Svondo rapera mapurisa anonzi akanyorera hutungamiri hweMDC-T kuMashonaland West tsamba achihuzivisa kuti vaifanirwa kutanga vapiwa mvumo nemadzishe pamwe nemasabhuku yekuti vaite misangano yavo.

MDC-T inonzi yanga yakaronga kuita misangano kwaKazangarare, Kenzamba neMakonde mukupera kwesvondo.

Hatina kukwanisa kubata mapurisa mudunhu iri kuti tinzwewo divi ravo panyaya iyi.
summary: Bato reMDC-T rinoti richaenderera mberi nekuita misangano yaro mudunhu reMashonaland West

title: Gungano Rinomirira Vashandi Vemumigodhi Yokumbira Hurumende Kuti Iwongorore Huwandu Hwenguva Irikushandwa Nevashandi Vemumigodhi
content:
Gurukota rezvemigodhi, vaObert Mpofu, vanoti hurumende iri kufara nebasa rakaitwa mukubatsira vanhu makumi mashanu pamugodhi weMimosa Platinum wekuZvishavane nezuro, zvichitevera kufa kwakanga kwaita mishina inotakura vashandi kubva mumugodhi ichivaendesa kunze.

Kufa kwemishina iyi kunonzi kwakakonzera moto nechihutsi izvo zvakakonzera kuti vaida kubatsira kuburitsa vashandi ava, vasaone mafambisiro ebasa zvakazokonzera kunonoka kweburitswa kwevashandi ava. VaMpofu vanoti hurumende ine mitemo yakasimba yekuchengetedza vashandi vemumigodhi. VaMpofu vanoti njodzi yanezuro yauya kwapfura nguva refu nekuti migodhi mizhinji yave kutevedzera mitemo yakadzikwa nehurumende yekuchengetedza hupenyu hwevashindi. Tsaona huru yemumigodhi yakapedzesera kuitika ku Hwange colliery mugore ra 1972 apo vashandi vanopfura mazana mana (400) vakarasikirwa nehupenyu.

Sangano rinomirira vashandi vemumigodhi, reNational Mine Workers Union, rinoti hurumende inofanirwa kugadzirisa nguva dzinoshandwa nevashandi vemimigodhi kuti vashandi ava vasashande kwemaawa masere vasina kuzorora sezvo izvi zvichizokonzera njodzi. Mutungamiri we sangano iri, va Shadreck Pelewelo, vanoti pari zvino basa richiri rakamira pamimosa mine sezvo mumugodhi uyu muchiri nehutsi. Va Pelewelo vanoti vaenda kuMimosa nhasi kunoona mamiriro akaita zvinhu uye vanofara nemabatirwo akaitwa tsaona yanezuro.

title: Archbishop Ncube Voramba Nyaya Yeupombwe Yavari Kupomerwa
content:
Mutungamiri we Roman Catholic muBulawayo, Archbishop Pius Ncube, vari kupomerwa mhosva yekuita zvehupombwe nemumwe mukadzi anogara muguta iri.

NeMuvhuro, nhepfenyuro ye ZBC yakaburitsa nyaya yekuti murume wa Rosemary Sibanda, VaOnesimo Sibanda, vanonzi vari kuda kuripwa 20 billion Zimbabwe dollars naVaNcube, avo vari kupomerwa mhosva yekuita zvehupombwe.

Mapepanhau ehurumende aburitsawo mifananidzo inzoni ndeya VaNcube vari mumba mavo nemukadzi uyu. VaNcube vari kuramba kutaura nezvenyaya iyi, uye mhosva yavari kupomerwa.

Munyori musangano re Zimbabwe Catholic Bishops Conference, Father Frederick Chiromba, vaudza Studio 7 kuti sangano ravo harisati razeya nyaya iyi, uye vachazobuditsa zvizere kana vabuda nechisungo pane zviri kuitika izvi.

Gweta riri kumirira Archbishop Ncube, VaNicholas Matonsi, vaudza Studio 7 kuti vaendesa magwaro kudare redzimhosva, ekuramba mhosva iyi. VaMathonsi, vati havatenderani nemabatirwo ari kuitwa nyaya iyi nehurumende yekubuditsa hwavari kuti humbowo, mumabepanhau pamwe nedzinhepfenyuro, sezvo izvi zviri zvinhu zvinozofanirwa kubuditswa mumatare edzimhosva.

Doctor Lovemore Madhuku inyanzvi munyaya dzemitemo, uye vanodzidzisa pa University of Zimbabwe.

Mutori wenhau we Studio 7 Carole Gombakomba ,aita hurukuro naVaMadhuku kuti tinzwe kuti danho ratorwa nemagweta aVa Ncube, rinorevei.

Tichiri panyaya iyi, nyanzvi mune zvematongerwo enyika dzinoti zviri pachena kuti kana dai Archbishop Ncube vaine mhosva panyaya iyi, zviri pachena kuti zvematongerwo enyika, ndizvo zvave kuendeswa pamberi, sezvo VaNcube vanga vari munhu anoshoropodza huipi hwehurumende.

Doctor John Makumbe vanodzidzisa pa University of Zimbabwe, uyezve vari nyanzvi mune zvematongerwo enyika, vaudza Carole Gombakomba weStudio7 kuti kutadza kwaVa Ncube hakuneyi nekutadza kutonga kwehurumende yaVa Mugabe.

title: South Africa Yoshorwa neKudzika Mutemo Unonzi Unodzvinyirira Vatori veNhau
content:
Masangano enhau muZimbabwe neChipiri akashora zvikuru paramende yemuSouth Africa nekupasisa bhiri reState Security Information Bill iro riri kushorwa nevakawanda kuti rinotyora kodzero dzevatori venhau uye kukurudzira huori muhurumende.

Paramende yeSouth Africa yakapasisa bhiri iri nemavhoti mazana maviri nemakumi maviri nemanomwe, ukuwo vanhu zana nemakumi manomwe vachiramba kuritambira.

Munyori mukuru mu ANC VaGwede Mantashe, vanoti mutemo uyu uchapa kuti vanhu vasafukure hapwa mukuchengetedza nyika. Vati vanhu vanenge vafukura hapwa vanofanira kuti varangwe.

Vamwe vashora mutemo uyu ndivaArchbishop Desmond Tutu, munyori ane mukurumbira pasi rose, Nadine Gordimer, uye hofisi yevaimbova mutungamiri weSouth Africa, VaNelson Mandela.

Vamwe varamba bhiri iri ndevemachechi, masangano evatori venhau, uye vakuru vemabhizimisi. Nyanzvi munyaya dzezvematongerwo enyika dzinoti zvichaomera vari kurwira kodzero dzevanhu munyika kuti vati Zanu-PF ibvise mitemo yakaita seAIPPA nePOSA.

Munyori mukuru weZimbabwe Union of Journalists, VaFoster Dongozi, vanoti ANC yave kutevera munzira dzeZanu-PF dzekutyora kodzero dzevanhu.

VaDongozi vanoti zvinhu zvinovhundutsa zvikuru. Mashoko aya atsinhirwa nemupepeti mukuru webepanhau reSunday Times, VaMondli Makhanya, avo vaudza Studio 7 kuti zviri kuitwa neANC zvinopa kuti musouth africa muite huori sezvo panenge pasina anenge okwanisa kufumura zvinenge zvoitika nekuda kwemutemo uyu.

Sachigaro weMISA-Zimbabwe, VaNjabulo Ncube vanoti zvaitwa neSouth Africa zvinhu zvadzorera chimurenga kumashure mukurwira kodzero dzevanhu.

title: Dynamos Yoshura Mare muMakwikwi eCastle Premier Soccer League
content:
Chikwata cheDynamos chasimbisa mukana wacho wekutora mukombe weCastle Lager Premier Soccer League nekudambura chikwata chinovatambudza cheCaps United.

Dynamos yakafadza vateveri vayo mushure mekunge chikwata ichi chakadambura Caps United 2-0 pamberi pechaunga chaityisa muNational Sports Stadium nemusi weSvondo.

Vese vaive munhandare iyi vanobvuma kuti Dembare yaikodzera kutora mapoinzi ese matatu sezvo vaipotsera mabhora akasimba pagedhe reMakepekepe, panguva iyo maGreen Machine aitamba zvekuda kufadza veruzhinji panzvimbo yekuenda kumberi kunokanda zvibodzwa.

Asi mutambo unokundwa nekukanda bhora mumambure izvo zvakaitwa neDynamos mushure mekuzunza mambure kaviri nezvibodzwa zvakabva kuna Christian Epoupa, weku Cameroon, uyo aita mukurumbira wekuona pane gedhe.

Izvi zviri kureva kuti Dynamos yatungamira Caps United 2-1 mumitambo mitatu yavatamba mwaka uno mushure mekurova MaGreen Machine mumukombe weIndependence Trophy, vabva mukukundwa mumakwikwi e ZNA Charity Shield.

Murairidzi weDynamos, Lloyd Mutasa, akati ari kufara zvikuru nekurova kwavakaita Caps United neSvondo asi achiwedzera iye kuti havasi kufarisisa sezvo vachiri nemumwe mutambo nechikwata chinovatambudza ichi.

Asi mutevedzeri wemurairidzi weCaps United, Fungai Kwashi, akati vari kurwadziwa zvikuru nekurohwa nechikwata icho vakavakidzana nacho muHarare kunyanya mumutambo weligi achitizve chibodzwa chechipiri cheDynamos chainge chisina kumira zvakaanaka.

Kukunda uku kwasimbisa mukana weDynamos wekutora mukombe weligi sezvo vave pachinhanho chechipiri kudarika Ngezi Platinum Stars iyo yakarohwa 1-0 neShabanie Mine kuMaglas Stadium, uyezve pamusoro peFC Platinum.

Asi Chicken Inn ndiyo ichiri pamusoro pemakundano aya mushure mekurova How Mine 2-1 neMugovera. Chikwata chaRahman Gumbo ichi chave nemapoinzi makumi mashanu nerimwechete, mapoinzi matatu pamusoro peDynamos, iyo ine nemitambo miviri yaisati yatamba.

FC Platinum ichirimowo zvakasimba mumakwikwi aya mushure mekufamba nzendo refu kuenda kuColliery uko yakanotora mapoinzi ese matatu nekurova Hwange 1-0.

FC Platinum yasvetuka uyezve nekusiya Ngezi Platinum Stars nemapoinzi maviri. Parizvino, chikwata chaNorman Mapeza ichi chine mapoinzi makumi mana nemasere, Ngezi ichiteverawo nemapoinzi makumi mana nematanhatu.

Asi kutambura kweHighlanders kuri kuramba kupera mushure mekunge Bosso yakarohwa 1-0 pamusha payo neChapungu. Highlanders yadzikira zvekuti yave pachinhanho chechinomwe uyezve kure kure nekutora mukombe weligi uyu.

Dynamos yakafadza vateveri vayo mushure mekunge chikwata ichi chakadambura Caps United 2-0 pamberi pechaunga chaityisa muNational Sports Stadium nemusi weSvondo.

title: FC Platinum neTraingle Dzosimudza Mureza weZimbabwe muAfrica
content:
Chikwata cheTriangle chakashura mare nezuro mumakwikwi eCAF Confederation Cup mushure mekudambura chikwata cheRukinzo chekuBurundi.

Asi chikwata cheFC Platinum chakaita mangange mumakwikwi eCaf Champions league neChikwata cheNyasa Big Bullets.

Chikwata cheTriangle nezuro chakarova Rukinzo yekuBurundi 5 kwa 0 izvo zvapa chikwata ichi mukana wekuenderera mberi mumakwikwi aya. Mutambo wechipiri uri kutambirwa kuBurundi svondo rino.

Mune mumwe mutambo neMugovera, chikwata cheFC Platinum chakaita manganga 0-0 nechikwata chinorairidzwa naCallisto Pasuwa uyu aimborairidza chikwa cheDynamos. Mutambo wechipiri uchatambirwa kuBarbourfields mavhiki maviri anotevera.

Iko zvino tombotarisa mitambo yeCastle Premier League yakatambwa mukupera kwesvondo.

Chikwata cheChicken Inn neBlack Rhinos zvatambisa mukana mukuru wavanga vawana wekuenda panhongonya yeCastle Premier Soccer League mushure mekurohwa mumitambo yazvo, ndokuramba zviine mapoinzi maviri pasi peFC Platinum iyo irikutungamira.

Black Rhinos yakarohwa 1-0 neHighlanders musi mumwechete Chicken Inn yakadamburwa 2-1 neZPC Kariba.

FC Platinum iyo yaive isina mutambo muZimbabwe irikutamba mutambo wayo wePSL neChitatu apo irikusangana neHarare City. Nechitatu zvekare, Triangle ichatamba ne Ngezi Platinum Stars.

Murwendo rwavo rwekuMalawi, mumutambo weCAF Champions League Pure Platinum Boys yakanoita mangange 0-0 ne Nyasa Bullets.

Asi Makepekepe eCaps United ari murufaro mushure mekushanya kwaRusape ndokunorova Manica Diamonds 1-0.

Izvi zvasiya maGreen Machine afamba nzendo refu ndokuenda pachinhanho chechipiri nemaponzi makumi maviri nerimwechete, poindi imwechete pasi peFC Platinum.

Mumwe mutsigiri weCaps United Muzvare Leslie Marufu varikufara zvikuru nezvakaitwa nechikwata chavo vachiti ivo Kepekepe ndizvo.

Mumusha weDembare mune rufaro mushure mekunge chikwata ichi charova Mushowani Stars 2-0 nezuro ndokuenda pamapoinzi makumi maviri nemanomwe.

Murairidzi wavo Tonderai Ndiraya arikuti chiwata chake chakabatana zvekuti arikutarisira mashiripiti mumitambo inotevera.

title: VaMutodi Vanodzingwa Basa naVaMnangagwa
content:
Mutungamiri wenyika, VaEmmerson Mnangagwa, vamisa basa mutevedzeri wegurukota rezvekuburitswa kwemashoko, VaEnergy Mutodi.

Muchiziviso chaburitswa nehofisi yaVaMnangagwa, VaMutodi vamiswa basa pasi pechikamu che Section 108 (1a) chebumbiro remitemo yenyika.

Mutemo uyu hautaure zvakawanda kunze kwekuti chigaro chegurukota kana chemutevedzeri wegurukota chinenge chisisina munhu kana mutungamiri wenyika abvisa munhu wacho pachigaro ichi.

Kumiswa basa kwaVaMutodi kwatanga neChitatu kunyange hazvo vaswera vari kuHeroes Acre uko kwanga kuchivigwa gamba renyika..

VaMutodi vaswera vachitumira mashoko nemavhidhiyo paTwitter yavo vachirumbidza basa ranga richiitwa naVaMnangagwa pakuradzika nhengo yeZanu PF, Va Absolom Sikhosana, kumarinda eHeroes Acre muHarare.

Studio7 haina kukwanisa kunzwa divi raVaMutodi kuti vanoti kudii nekusiyiswa basa kwavaitwa.

Hatinawo kukwanisa kunzwa kumunyori webazi rezvekuburitswa kwemashoko, VaNick Mangwana, avo vasiri kupindura mibvunzo yeStudio7 mazuva ano.

VaMutodi vagara vachinetsana pamwe nekuzvidza gurukota rezvekuburitswa kwemashoko, Amai Monica Mutsvangwa, pamwe nemurume wavo, VaChris Mutsvangwa.

Svondo rapera, VaMutodi vakaburitsa mashoko pa Twitter vachizvidza VaMutsvangwa vakatiwo nyika ichagara ichitya mushandira pamwe uri pakati pegurukota rezvekudyidzana nedzimwe nyika, VaSibusiso Moyo naVaMutsvangwa.

Mashoko aya akatevera mashoko akanga aburitswa neZBC ichitauta zvainge zvataurwa naVaMoyo zvekuti mashoko akanga aburitswa naVaMutodi panyaya yemutungamiri weTanzania, aive asina kumirira hurumende asi kuti aive mashoko epfungwa dzavo VaMutodi.

VaMutodi vakabva vatanga kushoropodza ZBC vachiti yaishandiswa naAmai Mutsvangwa nemurume wavo.

Asi VaMnangagwa havana kubuda pachena vachitsuura zvakange zvichitaurwa naVaMutodi, avo vakambokonzeresa mutauro munguva yaVaRobert Mugabe, vabuda zvakare pa social media vaina VaMnangagwa vakabata kapu yainge yakanyorwa kuti "I am the boss".

VaMnangagwa havasati vazivisa kuti VaMutodi vachatsiviwa nani, uye hazvisati zvajeka kuti chii chapa kuti VaMnangagwa vadzinge munhu anozivikanwa kuti mutsigiri wavo nguva dzose.
summary: Mutungamiri wenyika, VaEmmerson Mnangagwa, vamisa basa mutevedzeri wegurukota rezvekuburitswa kwemashoko, VaEnergy Mutodi.

title: Zimbabwe Human Rights Forum Inori Vanhu Gumi neVanomwe Vakaurayiwa neMauto
content:
Sangano rinorwira kodzero dzevanhu reZimbabwe Human Rights NGO Forum raburitsa gwaro rinoratidza kuti vanhu chiuru nemazana masere nevatatu vakatyorerwa kodzero dzavo nevanofungidzirwa kuti mauto, mapurisa nevechidiki veZanu-PF kubva musi wa15 Ndira kusvika musi wa 5 Kukadzi.

Gwaro reZimbabwe Human Rights NGO Forum rakanzi, “On the Days of Darkness in Zimbabwe”.

Sangano iri rinoti huwandu hwevanhu vakaurayiwa wasvika pagumi nevanomwe. Pavanhu vakaurayiwa apa pane madzimai maviri uye vanhu gumi nemumwe ndevemuHarare, mumwe chete kuBulawayo, Marondera, vaviri kuChitungwiza uye mumwe chete kwaMutare nekuKadoma.

Sangano iri rinoti rakwanisa kutaura nevanhu gumi nevasere vakabatwa chibharo vachiti zvakaitwa nemauto.

Rinotiwo vanhu makumi masere nemumwe vakapfurwa nepfuti. Mumwe mukuru wemauto VaDouglas Nyikayaramba nezuro vakazivisa kuti mauto apedza basa ravo uye ave kugadzirira kudzokera kumakamba avo kana mapurisa ati haachadi rubatsiro rwavo.

Vakatiwo mauto akapanduka ndiwo akaba pfuti ndokuuraya vanhu. Asi vanorwira kodzero dzevanhu vanoti izvi ndezvemugotsi matsuro.

title: Dare Rinotadza Zvakare Kunzwa Chikumbiro Chenhengo dzeMDC Dziri Muhusungwa
content:
Dare redzimhosva repamusoro rakundikana kunzwa chikumbiro chegweta riri kumirira nhengo dzeMDC dziri muhusungwa, chekuti vasungwa ava vapihwe mukana wekubvisa mari yechibatiso, kana kuti bail.

Dare rati nyaya iyi ichazeyiwa mudare svondo rinouya neChitatu. Izvi zvinotevera chikumbiro chaitwa nemuchuchisi chekuti nyaya idzi dzose dzibatanidzwe pamwe chete, uye mapurisa apihwe nguva yakakwana yekupedzisa kuferefeta nyaya dziri kupomerwa vanhu ava.

Mutongi wedare reHigh Court, VaBen Hlatshwayo, vati mapurisa akaendawo kuSouth Africa kunoferefeta nyaya dzekunzi vamwe vari muhusungwa ava vakadzidziswa zvehugandanga ikoko, anofanirwa kunge adzoka pazuva iri.

Vari muhusungwa vanosanganisirawo mumiriri weGlen View muparamende, VaPaul Madzore, mushandi anoona nezve kufambiswa kwemabasa muMDC, VaKudakwashe Matibiri, munyori anoona nezvekufambiswa kwemabasa ezvematongerwo enyika muMashonaland East, VaPineal Denga, pamwe nemushandi anoona nezve kufambiswa kwemashoko mubato iri, VaLuke Tamborinyoka.

Mumwe wavo, uye ari chipangamazano chaVaMorgan Tsvangirai, VaIan Makone, vakaburitswa muhusungwa neChitatu mushure mekubvisiswa mari inotyisa inoita $150 million sechibatiso.

Vanhu ava vakasungwa muna Kurume vachipomerwa mhosva dzine chekuita nekuda kubvisa hurumende yaVaMugabe pachigaro nechisimba. Asi vasungwa ava vari kuramba mhosva dzavari kupomerwa.

Gweta riri kumirira vasungwa ava, VaAlec Muchadeha,vaudza Studio 7 kuti vanga vachipokana nehurongwa hwekuti nyaya dzose dzibatanidzwe, asi nekuda kwekuti zvinhu zvifambire mberi, vazongobvuma.

VaPedzisayi Ruhanya, avo vanoongorora zvematongerwo enyika uye vachishanda neCrisis in Zimbabwe Coalition, vaudza mutori wenhau dzeStudio7, Jonga Kandemiiri, chinangwa chehurumende ndechekuda kurwadzisa nhengo dzebato rinopikisa idzi kuitira kuti dziore mwoyo.

title: NANGO Inoti RBZ Ngaidzosere Mari Yayakatoera Masangno Gore Rapera
content:
Sangano reNational Association of Non-Governmental Organisations, NANGO, rinoti rakanyorera tsamba kugurukota rezvemari, VaTendai Biti, richida kuti mari dzakatorerwa nhengo dzaro nebhanga guru renyika dzidzoserwe.

Gore rapera, gavhuna webhanga guru renyika, VaGideon Gono, vanonzi vakatora mari zvisina mvumo kubva muhomwe dzemasangano akazvimirira. Mari yakatorwa naVaGono inonzi inosvika mamiriyoni makumi mashanu emadhora ekuAmerica.

Mutauriri weNANGO, VaFambai Ngirande, vanoti sangano ravo riri kuda kuti VaBiti pavanoparura hurongwa hwemashandisirwo emari hwepakati pegore neChina, vazivise kuti vane hurongwa hwakadii hwekudzosera mari idzi kuvaridzi vadzo.

Studio7 haina kukwanisa kunzwa kuna VaBiti kuti vachafambisa seyi nyaya dzemari yakatorwa naVaGono iyi.

title: Kushomeka kweMvura Kwokanganisa Kurwisa Coronavirus muMaguta
content:
Kunyangwe hazvokuchengetedza hutsanana iri imwe yekurudziro huru yekurwisa hutachiwana hwecoronavirus kana kuti covid-19, vamwe vagari vemumaguta vari kutyira kuti kusawanikwa kwemvura yakachena kuchaisa hupenyu hwavo munjodzi huru.

Murwiri wekodzero dzevanhu uye vari mugari wemuguta reGweru Muzvare Nozipho Rutsate vanoti kanzuru yavo haikwanisi kupa vagari mvura yakachena rinova dambudziko guru panguva ino.

Mumwe mugari wemuBulawayo Muzvare Nozipho Moyo vanoti dambudziko remuguta mavo riri kuwedzerwa nekuti madhamu haanawo mvura yakakwana vachiti hurumende inofanira kupindira vanhu vasati vapera rumwe rumwe.

VaPrecious Shumba vanoshanda nesangano reHarare Residents Trust vanoti muHarare sekune mamwe maguta nemadhorobha ari munyika, vagarai vakawanda vemuHarare havawani mvura yakachena yakakwana.

Vanotiwo veruzhinji havakwanise kutenga mishonga yekugeza maoko inonzi saniter muchirungu, nekudaro vanhu vakawanda vanogona kuve panjodzi yekubatwa nechirwere checoronavirus.

Meya weguta reGweru VaJosiah Makombe vanovawo mukuru wesangano reUrban Councils Association of Zimbabwe, UCAZ vanobvuma kuti makanzuru akawanda munyika ane dambudziko guru rekutadza kupa vagari mvura yakakwana uye vanoti izvi zvinogonawo kukanganisa pakudzivirira zvirwrere.

VaMakombe vanoti sezvo chirwere checoronavirus riri dambudziko repasi rose vanovimba kuti hurumende ichabatsira makanzura kunyanya panyaya yemvura.

Studio 7 yayedza kubata kugurukota rezvekutongwa kwematunhu VaJuly Moyo kuti tinzwe divi ravo asi nharembozha yavo yange isingadairwe.

Mutevedzeri waVaMoyo, Amai Marian Chombo vakataurira Studio 7 munguva pfupi yapfuura kuti hurumende iri kuedza kugadzirisa dambudziko rekushaikwa kwemvura mumaguta nemumadhorobha nekupa makanzuru mari pasi pehomwe yekuendesa masimba kumatunhu.

Vakambove mutevedzeri wegurukota rezvehutano vari nhengo yebato reZanu PF Doctor Edwin hapana tsvakiridzo yakakwana yekuti kushaikwa kwemvura yakakwana mumaguta nemadhorobha kungakanganisa zvakadii kurwisa chirwere checoronavirus.

Asi vanobvuma kuti mvura yakakosha zvikuru pakuchengetedza hutsanana izvo zvinobatsira kurwisa zvirwere.

Munyori wezvehutano mubato reMDC inotungamirwa naVaNelson Chamisa Dr Henry Madzorera vanoti dambudziko rekushaikwa kwemvura mumaguta nemadhorobha rinoziikanwa nezvaro zvikuru, asi makanzuru anofanirwa kuedza zvose zvaanogona kuwanisa vanhu mvura kunyanya panguva ino.

Vanotiwo hurumende inofanirwa kubatsira veruzhinji nekuvapa mishonga yekugezesa maoko pachena.

Nyanzvi munyaya dzezvehutano dzinokurudzira kuti vanhu vachengetedze hutsanana nekushandisa masanitiser, kugeza maoko nemvura nesipo nguva nenguva uye kusaungana makawanda panzvimbo imwe chete, senzira yekudzivirira kutapurirana hutachiwana hwecoronavirus.

title: Mabhanga eStanbic neBaclays Oyambira Vanhu Kuti Vanogona Kutanga Kupihwa maBond Notes
content:
Kunyange hazvo veReserve Bank of Zimbabwe pamwe nehurumende vachiti vanhu havasi kuzomanikidzwa kushandisa mari yemabond notes iyo ichatanga kushanda mwedzi uno, mabhanga munyika anoti haasikuvimbisa vanhu kuti vacharamba vachiwana madhora ekuAmerica.

Vanotiwo madhora ekuAmerica ari kumaaccounts avo anogona kusandurwa kuve mari inenge ichidiwa neveRBZ.

Mabhanga akaita seStanbic neBarclays akatanga kunyorera vanoashandisa nemusi weChipiri kuti kubvira panotanga kushanda mari iyi achange ave kupa vanhu mari ipi zvayo pane dzese dziri kushandiswa munyika uye akati haasi kuvimbisa kuti vanhu vachawana mari dzavo dziri madhora eku America ayo ari kushandiswa zvakanyanya munyika.

Mutsamba yavakanyorera kuvanhu vanoshandisa bhanga iri, mukuru weStanbic muZimbabwe, VaJoshua Tapambgwa vanoti vasingagutsikane neizvi vanofanira kuenda kubhanga kwavo kuti vanopiwa tsanguro.

Tsanaguro yange ichipihwa ndeyekuti kunyange munhu akatumirwa kana kuisa mubhanga madhora ekuAmerica haakwanisi kutora mari iyi ari madhora ekuAmerica panguva ichatanga kushanda mabond notes.

VeBarclays vange vachitaura zvimwezvo vachiti vakuru vanoona nezvekushandiswa kwemari munyika veReserve Bank vanogona kuudza mabhanga zvekuita nguva ipi zvayo uye vanhu vanofanira kutarisira kuti mari dzavo dzichashandurwa kuve mabond notes kana mari ipi zvayo inobvumidzwa kushandiswa munyika.

Zimbabwe inoshandisa mari dzekunyika gumi neimwe kusanganisira mari yekuBritaina, China, Australia, Botswana neSouth Africa.

Zvave kuitika izvi hazvienderani nezvange zviri kutaurwa nemukuru weRBZ VaJohn Mangudya, mutevedzeri wavo VaKupukhile Mlambo pamwe negurukota rezvemari VaPatrick Chinamasa avo vaiudza vanhu kuti hapana achamanikidzwa kushandisa maBond Notes.

Mumwe mugari wemuHarare asina kufara nedanho riri kutorwa nemabhanga, VaMalvin Mukudu vanoti zviri pachena kuti veRBZ nehurumende vari kunyepera vanhu. Vanotiwo zviri pachena kuti hurumende iri kuda kudzora dhora remuno nerweseri.

Imwe nhengo yeZimbabwe Activists Alliance yekuManicaland, Tapiwa Chitambo audza Studio 7 kuti zvakuitwa nemabhanga izvi zvinoita kuti vanhu varegedze kuisa mari yavo mumabhanga zvachose.

Vanorirwa kodzero dzevanhu Muzvare Lynette Mudehwe vanoti vana vemuZimbabwe vanofanira kuramba mabond notes uye vanofanira kupihwa mari chaiyo.

Vanongorora zvematongerwo enyika, VaFortune Gwaze vanoti zviri pachena kuti mabhanga ari kumanikidzwa kuita zvinhu neRBZ.

Nyanzvi munyaya dzezvehupfumi vachishanda vakazvimirira, VaJames Johwa, vaudza Studio 7 kuti zviri kuitwa neRBZ nemabhanga kubira vanhu uye ndozvichaita kuti vanhu varambe mabond notes. VaJohwa vanoti zvinonetsa kuti vanhu vatambire zvinhu zvinotwa zvisina kujeka.

Pari zvino veRBZ vari kufamba nenyika yese vachikurudzira vanhu kuti vatambire mabond notes uye mutungamiriri wenyika VaRobert Mugabe vakatodzika mutemo unobvumidzwa kushandiswa kwemari yemaBond Notes.

Zvichakadaro Muzvinafundo Lovemore Madhuku vanoti nemusi weChina vachaendesa mapepa kudare repamusoro vachipikisa kuparurwa kwemabond notes uye zvakaitwa nemutungamiri wenyika VaRobert Mugabe zvekuita zanondega pakudzika mutemo wekuparura mabond notes.

Mamwe magweta akaita saMuzvare Fadzai Mahere vanoti mutemo waVaMugabe uri kunze kwemutemo uye vanhu vanofanira kuramba mari iyi.

Vachinyorawo padandemutande ravo reFacebook, gweta VaDavid Coltart, vakurudzira vanhu kuti varambe zviri kuda kuitwa nemabhanga izvi zvekuvapa mari dzese dzese.

Hatina kukwanisa kutaura nemukuru weRBZ VaJohn Mangudya kana VaChinamasa kuti tinzwe divi ravo panyaya iyi.
summary: Kunyange hazvo veReserve Bank of Zimbabwe pamwe nehurumende vachiti vanhu havasi kuzomanikidzwa kushandisa mari yemabond notes iyo ichatanga kushanda mwedzi uno, mabhanga munyika anoti haasikuvimbisa vanhu kuti vacharamba vachiwana madhora ekuAmerica.

title: Dare Rinoti MDC Renewal Team Haina Masimba eKuranga VaTsvangirai
content:
Chikwata cheMDC Renewal Team hachina masimba ekumisa mutungamiri weMDC, VaMorgan Tsvnagirai, pamberi pekomiti inotonga vanenge vatadza mubato.

Izvi zvaturwa nedare repamusoro zvichitevera kunzwikwa kwakaitwa nyaya iyi mudare iri China manheru.

Mutongi wedare iri, Va Happias Zhou, vati chipoka che MDC Renewal Team, ichi icho chiri kutungamirwa nevakadzingwa semunyori webato iri, Va Tendai Biti, hachibvumirwe kumisa Va Tsvangirai pamberi pekomiti yakaumbwa nechipoka ichi kuti ivatongese mhosva dzavari kupomerwa nechipoka ichi.

Sachigaro weMDC-T, Va Lovemore Moyo, pamwe nenhengo yekomiti yepamusoro yebato iri, Va Thamsanga Mahlangu, vakaenda kudare vachiti ve MDC Renewal Team havafanire kuenderera mberi nekuita zvavakabvumirana pamusangano wavanoti ndewe National Council ye MDC-T wakabuda nezvisungo zvakawanda zvinosanganisira kumbomisa basa Va Tsvangirai nevamwe vakuru-vakuru mubato iri.

Mutongo uyu usati waturwa, Va Tsvangirai vanga vatoenda ku Chiweshe kwavanoita musangano nevanhu vakakuvadzwa pamberi pesarudzo dzemutungamiri dzechipiri kana kuti run-off dzakaitwa musi wa 27 Chikumi 2008.

Va Zhou vati ve MDC Renewal Team havasi kuzobvumidzwa nedare kuti vaite chero chipi zvacho chakabvumiranwa pamusangano uyu uyo wakaitirwa mu Harare pa Mandel Training Centre kusvikira nyaya yakakwidzwa kudare naVa Tsvangirai yekuti Va Biti nevamwe vavo vavadzosere midziyo yebato ravo yavakapamba yanzwikwa. Va Tsvangirai vari kuda kuti dare ritaure kuti vatungamiri veMDCT chaivo ndevapi.

Mutongi wedare atiwo chipoka chaVa Biti chibhadhare mari dzemagweta panyaya yachakundwa nhasi iyi.

Chikwata ichi changa chichida kumisa Va Tsvangirai nhasi pamberi pekomiti yekuvatonga pamhosva yachiri kuvapomera yekutyora bumbiro remitemo yebato pamwe nekushandisa mhirizhonga mubato.

Chipoka ichi chiri kupomerawo Va Tsvangirai mhosva yekupinda muhurumende yemubatanidzwa yakanga iripo sarudzo dzisati dzaitwa vasina kupihwa mvumo nekomiti ye National Council.

Vanga vari gweta rava Moyo naVa Mahlangu panyaya iyi, Va Douglas Mwonzora, vati vafara zvikuru nemutongo waturwa nedare uyu.

Va Mwonzora, avo vanove zvakare mutauriri we MDC-T, vati hazviite kuti mutungamiri webato ravo agariswe padare repasi pemuti nevanhu vave nebato ravo.

Gweta ranga rakamirira MDC Renewal Team, Va Lovemore Madhuku, havana kuuya kudare paturwa mutongo uyu.

Asi vanotaura vakamirira chipoka ichi, Va Jacob Mafume, vati komiti yavo yasangana ikapa mutongo wayo kunyange hazvo VaTsvangirai vange vasipo.
summary: Chikwata cheMDC Renewal Team hachina masimba ekumisa mutungamiri weMDC, VaMorgan Tsvnagirai, pamberi pekomiti inotonga vanenge vatadza mubato.

title: Kunorapwa kuSingapore kwaVaMugabe Kwokonzera Mutauro
content:
Mutungamiri wenyika, VaRobert Mugabe, nemusi weChitatu vakasimuka munyika vakananga kuSingapore uko vanonzi vari kuenda kunoona vanachiremba vavo.

Mutauriri waVaMugabe, VaGeorge Charamba, vanoti rwendo urwu rwakagara rwarongwa kare uye VaMugabe vanotarisirwa kudzoka svondo rinouya.

Asi izvi hazvisi kumisa vanhu kutaura sechave chigariro musoro wetsuro kushaya nyanga pose panobuda vamugabe munyika.

VaMugabe vari kuenda kunorapwa kunze uku munyika vanachiremba navanamukoti vari mukuramwa mabasa uye vamwe vashandi vehurumende vazivisa kuti vave kupinda mukuramwa mabasa kutanga neMuvhuro.

Hurumende inoti haina mari asi nenzendo dzaVaMugabe kunze dzinonzi dzinodya mari yakawanda.

Munyika mune matambudziko emafashamu emvura asiya vakawanda vasina pekugara.

Mubato reZanu-PF hamunawo kugadzikana sezvo nemakore aVaMugabe pane kunetsana panyaya yekuti ndiyani achatora chigaro chavo.

Vanoongorora nyaya dzezvematongerwo enyika vakarerekera havo kubato reZanu-PF, VaGadzira Chirumuanzu, vanoti hapana chakaipa kuti VaMugabe vaende kunorapwa uye hapana chinokanganisika munyika nekuti vane vatevedzeri vavo.

Gweta rinorwira kodzero dzevanhu, uye vachishanda neHuman Rights Watch, VaDewa Mavhinga, vanoti VaMugabe vanofanira kuenda pamudyandigere nekuti havachakwanise kuita basa nemazvo nenyaya yekukwegura.
summary: Mutungamiri wenyika, VaRobert Mugabe, nemusi weChitatu vakasimuka munyika vakananga kuSingapore uko vanonzi vari kuenda kunoona vanachiremba vavo.

title: Pastor Mugadza Vonamatira Mhuri yekwaDzamara
content:
Mumwe mufundisi akasungwa muna Zvita mushure mekuratidzira kumusangano weZanu PF National Confrence kuVictoria Falls achiti mutungamiri wenyika, VaRobert Mugabe, vanofanirwa kugadzirisa matambudziko akatarisana nenyika, nhasi ashanyira mhuri yaVaItai Dzamara ndokuyinamatira.

Mufundisi Patrick Philip Mugadza veRemnant Church yekuKariba vakurudzira mhuri iyi kuti iregerere vakapamba VaDzamara gore rapera vachiti Mwari chete ndivo vanogona kuranga vanhu ava.

Mufundisi Mugadza vatanga hurongwa hwavo nhasi vachinamatira mhuri yaVaDzamara kumba kwavo kuGlen View 7

VaMugadza vati vaona zvakakodzera kumatira mhuri yaVaDzamara panguva ino apo iri kushushikana nekupambwa kwaVaDzamara.

Vati munamato chete ndiwo uchasimbisa mhuri iyi pamwe nekuipa tariro yekuti VaDzamara vadzoke kumba kwavo kuzogara nemhuri yavo.

Vanoti vanoziva kuti zvakaoma kuregerera, asi vati kana mhuri yaVaDzamara ikaita izvi, ichakomborerwa pamwe nekurerukirwa nehupenyu.

Mhuri yaVaDzamara yange ichisanganisira mudzimai wavo, Amai Sheffra Dzamara, vana nevanini’na vavo. Mhuri iyi yatiwo nyaya yekuregerera inyaya yavari kufunga nezvayo.

VaMugadza vaendawo panzvimbo yakapambwa VaDzamara vakaita munato nemuridzi wenzvimbo iyi pamwe nevamwe vange vachigerwa sezvaiitwa VaDzamara apo vakapambwa muna Kurume gore rapfuura.

Kunyange hazvo dare repamusoro rakati mapurisa nevasori vanofanira kuferefeta kuti VaDzamara vari kupi, hazvisati zvazikanwa kluti vari kupi uye VaMugadza vati izvi zvinosuwisa kuti munhu angashaikwa munyika ine vasori nemapurisa akawanda.

Vatiwo zviri pachena kuti hurumende iri kutadzira vazhinji munyika uye ndosaka vachiti panofanira kuumbwa imwe hurumende inogadzirisa zvinhu munyika inenge iine vanhu vasina kwavakarerekera.

Zvichakadai pamusangano wevanhu vakavhiringwa nemhirizhonga vakaurayirwa hama dzavo, vakakuvadzwa kana kudyirwa zvipfuyo zvavo wainge wakarongwa nesangano reHeal Zimbabwe Trust neChipiri, vanhu vakati vanoda kuripwa uye kuti vanhu vakapara mhosva vasungwe.

VaMugadza vatiwo vanotambira hurongwa hwehurumende hwekuumba komisheni yerunyararo nekuyananisana munyika uye nyika inogona kufambira mberi kana pakava nekuregererana nekuyanana munyika.

VaDzamara vakapambwa musi 9 Kurume gore rapera uye kusvika pari zvino havasi kuzivikanwa kuti vari kupi.

Masangano anorwira kodzero dzevanhu, mhuri yavo pamwe nenyika dzakasiyana dziri kurudzira hurumende yeZimbabwe kuti iite zvese zvainokwanisa kutsvaga VaDzamara.

Vasori nemapurisa vanoti vari kuferefeta asi kusvika pari zvino havana chavati vawana.

VaItai Dzamara mutori wenhau akambosendeka basa rake parutivi achiti ava kurwira kodzero dzevanhu kudzamara mutungamiri wenyika, VaRobert Mugabe, vasiya basa.
summary: Mumwe mufundisi akasungwa muna Zvita mushure mekuratidzira kumusangano weZanu PF National Confrence kuVictoria Falls achiti mutungamiri wenyika, VaRobert Mugabe, vanofanirwa kugadzirisa matambudziko akatarisana nenyika, nhasi ashanyira mhuri yaVaItai Dzamara ndokuyinamatira.

title: Masangano Oronga Kukwidza Hurumende kuMatare Kana Ikasagadza Komisheni yeRunyararo
content:
Masangano akazvimirira muZimbabwe anoti hurumende inofanirwa kugadza komisheni inoona nezverunyararo nekuregererana munyika kuitira kuti igadzirise zvinhu zviri kunetsa munyika.

National Peace and Reconciliation Commission iri mubumbiro remitemo yenyika rakatambirwa makore maviri apfuura.

Vachitaura pamusangano waitwa neChipiri muHarare, masangano anoti reZimbabwe Human Rights NGO Forum, Zimbabwe Center for Community Development, Zimbabwe Civic Education Trust ne Heal Zimbabwe Trust, ati achakwidza nyaya iyi kumatare kana mutungamiri wenyika, VaRobert Mugabe, vakaramba vakanyarara nenyaya yekugadzwa kwekomisheni iyi.

Nhengo yeZimbabwe Human Rights NGO Forum, VaShastry Njeru, vanoti hurumende inofanirwa kutevedzera zviri mubumbiro renyika nekuzadzikisa zviga zvirimo kusanganisira kugadza komisheni yerunyararo iyi.

Mukuru weZimbabwe Civic Education Trust, Muzvare Gladys Hlatshwayo, vanoti havawirirane nepfungwa dzekuti kushaikwa kwemari ndiko kuri kutadzisa kutanga kushanda kwekomisheni iyi, vachiti uku kungoshaya hany’a kwevatungamiriri venyika…

Mumwe anga ari pamusangano uyu, VaRashid Mahiya veHeal Zimbabwe Trust, vatiwo chiri kuwedzera mhirizhonga muZimbabwe inyaya yemapazi ehurumende anoda kuita zvematongerwo enyika uye asingaiti basa ravo nemazvo

National Peace and Reconciliation Commission yakapiwa makore gumi chete mubumbiro remitemo yenyika kubva zvakatanga kushanda bumbiro iri mugore ra2013.

Vemasangano akazvimirira vanoti pasina runyararo hakuna budiriro inoitika munyika.
summary: Masangano akazvimirira muZimbabwe anoti hurumende inofanirwa kugadza komisheni inoona nezverunyararo nekuregererana munyika kuitira kuti igadzirise zvinhu zviri kunetsa munyika.

title: Hurumende Inoramba Kuti VaMugabe Vari Kurwara
content:
Hurumende inoti hachisi chokwadi chiri kubuda mumapepanhau chekuti mutungamiri wenyika, VaRobert Mugabe, vari kurwara uye kuti vakambochengetedzwa muchipatara.

Izvi zvinotevera mashoko ari kubuda mumapepanhau anoti VaMugabe havasi kunzwa zvakanaka. Mashoko ari kubuda anoti VaMugabe vakatanga kurwara apo vainge vaenda kuzororo ku Malaysia, vakambogariswa muchipatara munyika iyi.

Zvinonziwo pavakadzokera kuZimbabwe svondo rapera, vakabatwa zvakare nehurwere, izvo zvakapa kuti vadzokere zvakare kunorapwa kuMalaysia.

Asi munyori webazi rezvekuburitswa kwemashoko, Va George Charamba, vanoti VaMubage vari pazororo ravo, uye vachadzokera kubasa munguva pfupi inotevera.

Mutauriri weZANU-PF, Va Rugare Gumbo, vanoti kune vanhu vanoshivira kuti dai VaMugabe vafa. VaGumbo vanoti vanhu ivavo ndivo vanogara vachifambisa mashoko ekunyeba vachiti VaMugabe murwere.

Asi VaGumbo vabvuma kuti havasati vaona VaMugabe kudzoka kwavakaita kubva kuzororo.

VaMugabe vari kusvika makore makumi masere nemanomwe mwedzi unouya, uye bato ravo rakabuda nechisungo chekuti ndivo vachamirira Zanu PF musarudzo yemutungamiri wenyika.

VaMugabe vakasarudzwa kuva muntungamiri wenyika muna 1980 uye vave nemakore makumi matatu nerimwe vachitonga.
summary: Asi mapepanhau anoti VaMugabe vakarapwa kuMalaysia

title: Vanhu Vogara Vakabatira Hana Mumaoko kuManzou
content:
Dare repamusoro neMuvhuro harina kutara zuva rekutanga kunzwa nyaya yakakwidzwa kudare nemagweta ari kumirira varimi vari paManzou avo vari kuda kunzi vabve papurazi iri kuitira kuti rigariswe mhuka.

Mhuka idzi dzinonzi dziri kuda kuchengetwa nemudzimai wemutungamiri wenyika, Amai Grace Mugabe.

Gweta revagari ava, VaTonderai Bhatasara, vainge vakwira kudare neChishanu vachigunu’una kuti hurumende yainge yaendesa mbizi papurazi iri idzo dzoonesa vanhu ava ndondo nekudya zvirimwa zvavo uye kutadzisa vana kutamba panze nekutya.

VaBhatasara vaudza Studio 7 kuti vachiri vakangomira negumbo rimwe kuti vanzwe kuti nyaya yavakapinza mudare ichanzwikwa riini.

Chikumbiro chavo kudare chaive chekuti mbizi mazana maviri dziri papurazi iri dzibviswe mumaawa makumi mana nemasere sezvo kudziendesa papurazi iri kwaive kutyora mutongo wedare rainge rati vanhu ava vasabviswe papurazi vasina kuwanirwa pamwe pekugara sezvinodiwa nebumbiro remitemo.

Vari kunzi vaite izvi igurukora rezvezviwanikwa, VaSaviour Kasukuwere, gurukota rezveminda, VaDouglas Mombeshora, gurukota rezvemukati menyika, VaKembo Mohadi, uye bazi rezvemhuka dzesangano, reZimbabwe Parks and Wildlife Management Authority.

Hatina kukwanisa kubata makurukota aya kuti tinzwe divi ravo. Asi vagari ava vanoti vari kushushukana nekuti pane vanhu vauya neMuvhuro vachiti ndevekubazi rekuverengwa kwevanhu vachinyora mazita avo.

Mumwe mugari wepapurazi iri, VaTichaona Mabhuru, vanoti papurazi iri hapana mufaro sezvo vanhu vari kutya kuti mapurisa anogona kuuya kuzovashungurudza.
summary: Dare repamusoro neMuvhuro harina kutara zuva rekutanga kunzwa nyaya yakakwidzwa kudare nemagweta ari kumirira varimi vari pamanzou avo vari kuda kunzi vabve papurazi iri kuitira kuti rigariswe mhuka.

title: Rutsva rweWikiLeaks Rwosvibisa Maoko Akawanda muZimbabwe
content:
Zvinhu hazvina kumira zvakanaka mumapato ezvematongerwo enyika zvichitevera mashoko akaburitswa ne WikiLeaks pamusoro pemashoko akataurwa nevakuru mumapato muhurukuro dzemuchivande dzavakaita nevaimbove vamiriri veAmerica mu Zimbabwe, Ambassador Chrostopher Dell na Ambassador James McGee.

WikiLeaks yakaburitsa svondo rapera hurukuro dzakaitwa pakati penhengo mbiri dze MDC-T, Va Nelson Chamisa, munyori anoona nezvekufambiswa kwemabasa ezvematongorwo enyika mubato iri, pamwe naVa Obert Gutu, mutauriri weHarare mubato apo vakasangana naVa McGee.

Vaviri ava vanonzi vakati mutungamiri wavo, VaMorgan Tsvangirai, munhu asina kusimba zvakadzama mukutungamira bato. Vaviri ava vanonzi vakawiriranawo kuti VaTsvangirai munhu anonetseka pakutora matanho akadzama.

WikiLeaks yakaburitsawo hurukuro dzakaitwa pakati pemumiriri weAmerica nagavhuna webhanga guru renyika, Va Gideon Gono, vachiti vakaudzwa kuti mutungamiri wenyika, VaRobert Mugabe, havana hupenyu hwakareba sezvo vari kurwara nechirwere chegomarara. VaGono vanoti vakaudzwa nemudzimai waVaMugabe kuti VaMugabe munhu akura anofanirwa kusiya basa.

VaGono vanonzi vakaudza VaMcGee muna 2008 kuti VaMugabe vasarirwa nemakore matatu kana mashanu kuti vafe nechirwere chiri kuvanetsa. Asi Va Gono vari kuramba mashoko aya mupepanhau re Newsday.

Nyanzvi mune zvematongerwe enyika, Va Charles Mangongera, vanoti pane zvizhinji zvichachinja mu ZANU-PF kuburikidza nezvabuda mu WikiLeaks, kunyanya kudonhedzwa kwevakabuda mumagwaro aya. Imwe nyanzvi munyaya dzezvematongerwo enyika, Va George Shire, vanoti zviri kubuda mu WikiLeaks zvinhu zvagara zvichizivikanwa nevanhu munyika, uye hazvina zvazvinoshandura.
summary: Vanhu vobatira hana mumaoko nekutya WikiLeaks

title: South Africa Inoburitsa Gwaro Rinosungisa Amai Grace Mugabe
content:
South Africa yaburitsa gwaro rekuti mudzimai wevaimbove mutungamiri wenyika, Amai Grace Mugabe, vasungwe zvichitevera kukuvadza kwavakaita tsvarakadenga yemu South Africa, Gabriella Engels, gore rapera.

Mutauriri wemapurisa muSouth Africa, VaVishnu Naidoo, vanoti ichokwadi kuti Amai Mugabe vanofanirwa kusungwa, uye vava kutsvaga rubatsiro rwe Interpol. Sangano reAfriforum, richimirira Engels, rakaendesa nyaya yekuti Amai Mugabe vasungwe muna Chikunguru.

Gweta reAfriForum, VaWillie Spies, vaudza Studio7 kuti sangano ravo rinofara nezvaitika kunyange hazvo vasingagone kuunza Amai Mugabe muSouth Africa kuti vazotongwa.

Nyaya yekuti Amai Mugabe vasungwe yakonzeresa kupesana muhurumende.

Vachibvunzwa nezvehurongwa hwemapurisa emu South Africa kuti Amai Mugabe vasungwe, gurukota rezvekuburitswa kwemashoko, Amai Monica Mutsvangwa, varamba kupindura mibvunzo yevatori venhau.

Asi mutevedzeri wavo, VaEnergy Mutodi, vaudza Reuters kuti havaoni hurumende ichisiya Amai Mugabe vachifumurwa kuburikidza nekuvasiya vachisungwa, kana kuvaisa mumaoko emapurisa emu South Africa.

South Africa ne Zimbabwe dzine chibvumirano chekupana vasungwa. Muaturi webazi rezvekuburitswa kwemashoko, VaNick Mangwana, vaudza Studio 7 kuti hurumende yeZimbabwe haina zvaichaita pamusoro penyaya iyi kusvika South Africa yazivisa hurumende yeZimbabwe nezvenyaya iyi.

Amai Mugabe vanonzi vakarova Engels pane imwe hotera muJohannesburg gore rapera.

Magweta aEngels anoti Amai Mugabe vakatyora mutemo nokudaro vaifanirwa kumiswa pamberi pedare redzimhosva.

Asi hurumende yeSouth Africa yakati Amai Mugabe havafainrwa kumiswa pamberi pematare sezvo mitemo inobata diplomatic immunity yaisabvumira kuti vabatwe nenzira iyi.

Asi magweta aEngels akakwidza nyaya iyi kumatare achiti Amai Mugabe pavakapara mhosva, vakanga vasiri pabasa pavaiva muSouth Africa, nokudaro vaifanirwa kubatwa semunhuwo zvake apara mhosva.
summary: South Africa yaburitsa gwaro rekuti mudzimai wevaimbove mutungamiri wenyika, Amai Grace Mugabe, vasungwe zvichitevera kukuvadza kwavakaita tsvarakadenga yemu South Africa, Gabriella Engels, gore rapera.

title: Kalisto Pasuwa Anogeza Maoko Ake saMambo Pirato
content:
Muraidzi wechikwata chenyika chevakuru nechevadiki, KalistoPasuwa, aregedza basa.

Pasuwa akaregedza basa nezuro apo chikwata chemaYoung Warriors chakadzoka kubva kuSouth Africa uko vakanorohwa 3-0.

Pasuwa akazivisa veZimbabwe Football Association kuti haangarambe achishanda pasina mubhadharo wemari yemuhoro, iyo asina kubhadharwa kwemwedzi gumi iyo anga ari pabasa.

Maneja waPasuwa, VaGibson Mahachi, vanoti Pasuwa akaregedza basa uye ave kutarisa mamwe mabasa ari kuuya pamberi pavo.

Runyerekupe rwuri kufamba muHarare nderwekuti Pasuwa angangodzokera kuDynamos mushure mekudzingwa basa kwa David Mandigora semurairidzi wechikwata ichi.

Aimbove kit manager wemaWarriors, VaJoshua Khumalo, avo vasina zvekare kubhadharwa panguva iyo vaive pabasa, vanoti Pasuwa atora danho rakanaka pane kuti ashandire mahara.

VaKhumalo vanoti vari kushamisika kuti veZifa havasi kubhadhara vashandi vavo ivo vachiwana mari inobva kuFifa yerutsigiro.

Muteveri wenhabvu, VaProsper Muzanharwo, vanoti kurohwa kwakaitwa maYoung Warriors kuSouth Africa hakuneyi nematambiro avo asi kuti vaive nenzara nemhaka yekunyimwa mari neveZifa ivava.

Mushamarari wezvemitambo, Howard Musonza, anoti veZifa vakundikana zvekuti vanofanira kubviswa pabasa kana vachitadza kubhadhara vanovashandira.

MaYoung Warriors achaenda kumaAfrica Games kuCongo Brazaville muna Gunyana aine murairidzi mutsva, Nation Dube, uyo aive mutevedzeri waPasuwa.

MaWarriors zvekare achange aine murairdzi mutsva apo ari kutamba neGuinea mumakundano e2017 Africa Cup of Nations mukutanga kwaGunyana.
summary: Pasuwa akaregedza basa nezuro apo chikwata chemaYoung Warriors chakadzoka kubva kuSouth Africa uko vakanorohwa 3-0.

title: Akcijski načrt nemoči
content:
Medtem ko v Bruslju pripravljajo revizije schengenskega zakonika in dublinskih pravil, slednja naj bi vključevala tudi sicer nujno načelo, da beguncem ne bo treba zaprositi za azil v prvi državi vstopa v Evropsko unijo, se države članice v odsotnosti volje po medsebojni delitvi odgovornosti za begunce lotevajo priprav za zapiranje meja. Od Švedske do Slovenije so države v sprintu oblikovanja azilnih pravil in druge zakonodaje, ki bi Evropo naredila manj »atraktivno« za prihod beguncev. Odvzemanje denarja beguncem na Danskem (podoben ukrep je uvedla še Švica), da bi z njimi poplačali stroške njihove oskrbe, je zgolj vrh ledene gore in močno spominja na nacistično razlastninjenje Judov, Romov in številnih drugih evropskih narodov pred odhodom v koncentracijska taborišča.

Neonacistični duh se ne preliva zgolj iz zaskrbljenih civilnodružbenih gibanj tako imenovanih zaskrbljenih državljanov iz ene članice v drugo, njegove prvine so v spirali sovraštva opozicijskih populistov našle mesto še v evropskih vladnih politikah. Države tako tudi na pravnem področju sledijo vsesplošni ksenofobični hajki. Sprožila pa jo je prav politika prestrašene, razdeljene in nesolidarne Evrope, po kateri so žičnate ograje in suspendiranje schengenskih pravil najboljša možna rešitev za človekoljubnost, izpolnjevanje obvez do beguncev, ki izhajajo iz ženevskih konvencij, ter hkrati za ohranitev tako imenovanega našega načina življenja.

Ko je premier Miro Cerar pri nemški kanclerki Angeli Merkel razlagal še o enem načrtu reševanja begunske krize na meji z Makedonijo, je ležal v vsesplošnem evropskem trendu s severa in vzhoda Evrope. Ideja o zaščiti makedonsko-grške meje z evropskimi policisti je zvenela kot kopija že potekajočega pošiljanja policistov višegrajske četverice na druge evropske meje. Združil ga je z duhom zahodnih Evropejcev – predvsem Nemcev in Avstrijcev –, da je treba begunski tok ustaviti čim dlje od njihovih nacionalnih meja. Toda slovenska zamisel prej kot rešitev predstavlja v evropskem ksenofobičnem kontekstu zgolj še eno kapljo v morju Unijinega akcijskega načrta nemoči.

Ker je Merklova pod vse večjimi notranjepolitičnimi pritiski za končanje begunske politike »odprtih vrat«, Avstrija pa pod taktirko notranje ministrice Johanne Mikl - Leitner pripravlja zavračanje vseh beguncev, ki za azil ne nameravajo zaprositi pri njih ali v Nemčiji, je precej jasno, da je Evropa pred zapiranjem meja.
summary: Zgolj dva meseca po sprejemu akcijskega načrta s Turčijo, s katerim naj bi zajezili dotok beguncev v Evropsko unijo, v Bruslju ugotavljajo, da sicer zmanjšano število beguncev še vedno presega evropska pričakovanja. Ker za zdaj nič ne kaže, da bodo sirske begunce z delnimi vizumskimi omejitvami vstopa v Turčijo in ponujanjem omejenega števila delovnih dovoljenj lahko množično prepričali o nenadaljevanju poti proti EU, se evropske države vse od novega leta še naprej odzivajo panično. Kot neučinkovit pristop omejevanja begunskega toka proti srednji in severni Evropi se je izkazalo tudi vzpostavljanje žariščnih točk v Grčiji in Italiji, kjer bi ločevali do mednarodne zaščite upravičene begunce in ekonomske migrante. Omejevanje prehajanja beguncem določenih nacionalnosti v Makedoniji, kar je sicer eklatantna kršitev mednarodnega prava, je sicer delno zmanjšalo prehajanje zavrnjenih migrantov v EU, a hkrati spet priskrbelo nov posel tihotapcem ljudi.

title: Uporabniki facebooka zahtevajo strožje ukrepe proti seksizmu
content:
Protestniška kampanja se osredotoča predvsem na objave na facebooku, ki omenjajo posilstvo in drugo nasilje uperjeno proti ženskam kot pozitivno stvar. Spletna peticija, ki je sicer nastala vzporedno z omenjenim prizadevanjem, je že zabeležila preko 220.000 podpisov podpore.

Skupina protestnikov, med katerimi so tudi članice organizacij Action and the Media (WAM) in Everyday Sexism project, so v odprtem pismu Facebooku zahtevale hitro in korenito ukrepanje. Naprošajo tudi uporabnike, naj pišejo podjetjem, ki oglašujejo na družbenem omrežju, naj ta podprejo njihov cilj.

Primer spornega vedenja so denimo facebook skupine z imeni kot je: Zaradi tega pa so indijska dekleta posiljena. Njej avtor recimo objavlja fotografije zlorabljenih žensk. Ob eni od teh fotografij je zapis: „Drugič pa raje ne zanosi.“
summary: Na tisoče uporabnikov družbenega omrežja facebook se je preko spleta združilo v skupni želji, da od odgovornih zahtevajo strožje ukrepe proti objavam, ki ponižujejo ženske. Več kot 50 tisoč ljudi je namreč tvitalo v podporo omenjenemu cilju.

title: Vashandi veManline Transport Voenderera Mberi Vachiramwa Mabasa
content:
Gweta riri kumirira vatyairi vemagonyeti vekambani y Manline Transport avo vakakanda mapadza pasi svondo rapera vachiratidzira kusafara kwavo nemabatirwo avari kuitwa nekambani iyi, Va Paul Machiridza, vanoti vaita misangano nemagweta ekambani iyi kuti vakwanise kuyananisa gakava riripo.

VaMachiridza vanoti misangano iyi icharamba ichienderera mberi kusvika zvinhu zvagadziriswa.

Magweta anomirira kambani ye Manline Transport vaudza Studio7 kuti ichokwadi kuti vasangana nemagweta evashandi vekambani iyi asi havakwanise kutaura pasoro penyaya iyi.

Vashandi vanodarika makumi mashanu vapinda musvondo rechipiri vakamisa mota dzavo kumugunhu wenyika pamwe nemuHarare.

Mumwe wevatyairi vedzimota idzi ati anoda kuzivikanwa nezita rekuti VaGodwin Mafirakureva vanoti mabatirwo avari kuitwa nekambani iyi ari kuvashungurudza.

Vashandi ava vonoti kambani yavo iri kuvadzvinyirira uye yakambokomekedzwa nematare emuSouth Africa nguva yapfuura kuti ibhadhare vashandi vavo mari iri pamutemo asi vanoti haisi kutevedzera kurudziro iyi.
summary: Gweta riri kumirira vatyairi vemagonyeti vekambani ye manline avo vakakanda mapadza pasi svondo rapera vachiratidzira kusafara kwavo nemabatirwo avari kuitwa nekambani iyi, va paul machiridza, vanoti nhasi vaita misangano nemagweta ekambani iyi kuti vakwanise kuyananisa vaviri ava.

title: ZCTU Yoyambira Kuti Munyika Muchaita Kuratidzira Kunotyisa
content:
Sangano guru rinomirira vashandi munyika reZimbabwe Congress of Trade Unions razivisa kuti munyika muchave nekuratidzira kwakakomba mumazuva mashoma ari kutevera richiti harisi kufara nekusamira zvakanaka kwezvinhu munyaya dzezvehupfumi.

Vachitaura nevatori venhau pamahofisi esangano ravo, mutungamiri weZCTU, VaPeter Mutasa, vati vashandi vazhinji pamwe nerudhende rwese rwevanhu munyika vari kunhonga svosve nemuromo sezvo vachiti hupfumi hwenyika hwaenda kumawere.

VaMutasa vati mari yemunyika haisisina simba zvekuti vave kutoda kuti vashandi vose munyika vabhadharwe nemari dzekunze angave madhora ekuAmerica kana mari yekuSouth Africa vachiti maRTGS ari kutambirwa nevanhu munyika akangofanana nemutero wembwa.

VaMutasa vati chasara ndechekuti vashandi vose vachipinda mumigwagwa kudzamara zvavari kuda zvose zvagadziriswa nehurumende.

Vaenderera mberi vachiti huori hwapfunya chisero muhurumende zvekuti vamwe vakuru-vakuru muhurumende vave kufanira kusiya basa uye vamwe vavo vachiendeswa mujeri.

Hatina kukwanisa kutaura negurukota rinoona nezvevashandi, VaPaul Mavhima, kuti tinzwe divi rehurumende panyaya dzemari dzemihoro sezvo vanga vasiri kudaira nharembozha yavo.

Hurumende svondo rino yakati yawedzera vashandi vayo mari dzemihoro nezvikamu makumi mashanu kubva muzana pamari dzavanga vachitambira uye madhora ekuAmerica makumi manomwe nemashanu kwemwedzi mitatu.

Masangano evashandi akaramba kutambira mari yakawedzerwa nehuruemende iyi achiti mari iyi haina zvainokwana.

Zvichakadai, munyori mubazi rezvekuburitswa kwemashoko, VaNick Mangwana, vaudza Studio7 parunhare kuti basa remasangano evashandi akaita seZCTU nderekugara pasi nehurumende kuitira kuti vashandi vakwidzirwe mari dzemihoro vachiti ndosaka hurumende yakadzosa gungano reTripartite Negotiating Forum kuitira kuti hurumende, vashandi nevashandirwi vakwanise kugara pasi vachiita nhaurirano.

Asi VaMutasa vati hapana chiri kubuda kunhaurirano idzi sezvo vachiti hurumende iri kuramba yakaisa zvimiti munzeve.

Panyaya yekuti vamwe vari muhurumende vasiye basa pamusoro penyaya dzehuori, VaMangwana vati ZCTU haifanire kuita zvekurwisana nehurumende vachiti mikova yehurumende yakavhurika kuti paite nhaurirano.

Vati kusiya basa kwevari muhurumende kuri kutaurwa neveZCTU kurota masikati machena. Zvataurwa naVaMangwana zvatsigirwawo nemushandi mukuru anoona nezvekuburitswa kwemashoko muZanu PF, VaTafadzwa Mugwadi.

Zvichakadai, VaMutasa vakurudzira masangano akaita seSADC, African Union pamwe neUnited Nations kuti aise maziso awo paZimbabwe pavachange vachiratidzira vachiti hurumende inogona kutyora kodzero dzevanhu panguva iyi.

Asi mutungamiri webato reAfrican Devlopment Party, VaAckson Potera, vati kuratidzira kuri kuda kuitwa neZCTU kuchapinza veruzhinji panjodzi nekuda kwechirwere cheCovid19.

Asi mutungamiri weDemocratic Party, VaWururai Zembe, vati zviri kutaurwa neZCTU zvine musoro sezvo vachiti zvinhu zvasvika pakaomamunyika.

Pakashevedzerwa kuratidzira neZCTU gore rapera, pakarohwa vanhu vakawanda vamwe vakasungwa vamwe vakafa mushure mekupfurwa nevanofungidzirwa kuti masoja.

title: Dare Rinorasa Chikumbiro chaVaChamisa Chekuti Muzvare Khupe Vasashandise Zita reMDC-T
content:
Mutongi wedare repamusoro muBulawayo, Justice Francis Bere, varasa chikumbiro chechimbi-chimbi chebato reMDC -T inotungamirwa naVaNelson Chamisa chekuti Muzvare Thokozani Khupe nevamwe vavo vasashandise zita rebato reMDC- T.

VaBere vati chikumbiro chechikwata cheMDC T yaVaChamisa hachingawonekwe sechechimbi-chimbi sezvo paine makakatanwa pakati pechikwata ichi nechinotungamirwa naMuzvare Khupe ekuti ndechipi chikwata chaicho pakati pezviviri izvi chine kodzero yekunzi ndicho MDC-T yechokwadi.

Dare ratiwo chikwata chaVaChamisa chakakwidza nyaya iyi mudare chibvise mari yekabhadhara magweta nechikwata chaMuzvare Khupe icho chaipikisa nyaya iyi.

Gweta raMuzvare Khupe, Muzvinafundo Lovemore Madhuku, vati vafara nemutongo wedare nekuti zvagara zviri pachena kuti pari zvino pazvikwata zviviri zveMDC T hapana chine kodzero yekuudza chimwe zvekuita.

VaMadhuku vati zvaturwa mudare zvinosimbisa nyaya yavakakwidza kudare reConstitutional Court yekupikisa kudzingwa kwaMuzvare Khupe kubva mudare reparamende vachiti MDC-T yaVaChamisa yange isina kodzero yekuita zvayakaita.

MDC-T inotungamirwa naVaChamisa yaive yakwira kudare mushure mekunge Muzvare Khupe vanyora tsamba kuZimbabwe Electoral Commission vachiti ndivo mutungamiri chaiye weMDC-T.

Gweta reMDC T inotungamirwa naVaChamisa, VaLucas Nkomo, vati havana kufadzwa nemutongo waturwa naJustice Bere vakati vachaona kuti vokwira kudare reSupreme Court kana kuti kwete mushure mekuona mutongo waturwa naVaBere zvizere.

VaNkomo vati sezvo sarudzo dzave pedyo, kuti zvikwata zviviri zveMDC T izvi zvirambe zvichishandisa zita rimwe chete kunogona kuvhiringidza vamwe vatsigiri pakuziva kuti bato ravo chairo nderipi.

VaJameson Timba avo vanove nhengo yenational council yechikwata cheMDC T Chamisa vati vachatura kubato ravo zvabuda mudare uye vachaziva kuti votora gwara ripi mushure mekunge national council yebato iri yagara pasi mangwana ichizeya nyaya iyi.

Muzvare Khupe, avo vanoti ndivo vane kodzero yekutungamira MDC-T mushure mekufa kwaVaMorgan Tsvangirai, vakadomwa kuve mutungamiri wechikwata chavo cheMDC T pakongiresi yechimbi-chimbi yakaitwa nemusi weMugovera.

MDC-T izita raishandiswa munguva yesarudzo neMDC panguva iyo yaitungamirwa naVaMorgan Tsvangirai vasati vafa.

Izvi zvakaitirwa kuti vatsigiri vaVaTsvangirai vazive pekuvhotera zvichitevera kupatsanuka kwebato iri muna 2005.

Musarudzo dza 2008 ne 2013,VaWelshman Ncube nebato ravo vakakwikwidza vachishandisa zita rekuti MDC, ukuwo VaTsvangirai vakashandisa zita rekuti MDC-T, asi zita chairo rebato riri MDC.
summary: Dare ratiwo chikwata chaVaChamisa chakakwidza nyaya iyi mudare chibvise mari yekubhadharwa magweta nechikwata chaMuzvare Khupe.

title: Vanhu Voudza VaTsvangirai Kuti Vapinde Mumubatanidzwa Zvine Hungwaru
content:
Mutungamiri webato guru rinopikisa reMDC, VaMorgan Tsvangirai, vanoti vari kufara nezviri kubuda mumisangano yavari kuita vachitenderera nenyika yose, nanazvipangamazano pamwe nevatsigiri vavo avo vari kuvapa mvumo yekubatana nemamwe mapato pasarudzo dzegore rinouya.

Vachitaura neStudio7 kwaMpandawana kwaGutu neChishanu, pakupera kwemusangano waitwa wakavharwa misuwo, VaTsvangirai vati kunyange vanhu vari kuvapa mvumo yekubatana nevamwe, vazhinji munzvimbo dzavafamba vari kuratidza kusavimba nemamwe mapato vachiti vanogona kuzovanyengedza.

VaTsvangirai vati vana chipangamazano pamwe nevane pfungwa dzinobatsira mukusimudzirwa kwemaruwa vari kuvakurudzira kuti vapinde mumubatanidzwa uyu vakangwarira mamwe mapato.

VaTsvangirai vataura nanachipangamazano nevatungamiri vekumaruwa, kusanganisira madzishe nemasabhuku.

Vati musangano wavo hausi kufara kuti madzishe nemasabhuku ataura mumusangano kuti vari kushungurudzwa neZanu PF vachimanikidzwa kumanikidza vanhu mumaruwa kuti vaite zvavasingadi.

Vatungamiri venharaunda yemuGutu vakurudzira VaTsvangirai kuti vaenderere mberi nekubatana nevamwe asi vashare mapato ane musoro uye anokwanisa kuunza huwandu hunodiwa kuti vabvise pachigaro hurumende iri kutonga.

Mumwe wevakadaro ndiVaWatson Manamike vekuDewure, avo vayambira VaTsvangirai kuti vatange vaongorore kuti mamwe mapato ari pachokwadi here kupinda mumubatanidzwa uyu.

Asi pane vamwe vakaita saVaNevson Mushayi varamba zvemubatanidzwa vachiti mapato mamwe anopikisa haasi pachokwadi uye anoda kuzovhiringidza VaTsvangirai nebato ravo.

Vamwe vatsigiri vanoti havanyatsovimbe nemamwe mapato kunyanya ane vazhinji vakabva muZanu PF vachiti vanogona kunge vakatumwa vachida kuzovanyengedza vovavhiringidza.

Asi VaTsvangirai vati vavimbisa vanhu kuti vari kukoshesa zvakawanda uye vane chivimbo chekubatana nemapato avanoona kuti ari pachokwadi chekubatsira vana veZimbabwe kubvisa hutungamiri hwemutungamiri wenyika, VaRobert Mugabe.
summary: VaTsvangirai vati kunyange vanhu vari kuvapa mvumo yekubatana nevamwe, vazhinji munzvimbo dzavafamba vari kuratidza kusavimba nemamwe mapato vachiti vanogona kuzovanyengedza.

title: VaChihuri Vanoti Mapurisa Achasunga Vanoita zveMhirizhonga
content:
Mukuru wemapurisa, VaAugustine Chihuri, vanoti vezvematongerwo enyika vanofanirwa kusiyana nepfungwa dzinokonzeresa mhirizhonga munyika.

VaChihuri vanoti mapurisa achasunga ani nani zvake anenge akonzeresa mhirizhonga munguva yereferendamu pamwe nesarudzo dziri kutarisirwa kuitwa gore rinouya.

VaChihuri vakataura mashoko aya pamusangano wepagore wevakuru vemapurisa wakaitirwa kuDarwendale mazuva mashoma apfuura.

Mashoko aVaChihuri anouya panguva iyo vatungamiri vemapato ezvematongerwo enyika ari muhurumende vakabatana mukushoropodza mhirizhonga.

Mapato maviri eMDC anogaropomera mapurisa mhosva yekusaita basa nemazvo vachiti vanongosunga vemapato avo chete asi vasingasungi nhengo dzeZanu PF dzinenge dzakonzeresa mhirizhonga.

MDC-T yagara ichitiwo mapurisa ndivo vanotokonzeresa mhirizhinga nguva zhinji.

Mutauriri webato iri, VaDouglas Mwonzora, vaudza Studio 7 kuti mashoko aVaChihuri aya manatsa mukanwa chete sezvo vachiziva zvavo kunowira tsvimbo nedohwe.

Mutauriri weMDC inotungamirwa naVaWelshman Ncube, VaNhlanhla Dube, vaudzawo Studio7 kuti bato ravo richamirira kuona kana VaChihuri nemapurisa avo vachamira nemashoko avo ekuti vachasunga ani nani zvake akonzeresa mhirizhonga.

Hatina kukwanisa kubata mutauriri weZanu PF, VaRugare Gumbo.

Asi mukokeri weZanu PF mudare reparamende, VaJoram Gumbo, vatiwo mashoko aVaChihuri anotsinhira zvavagara vachitaura sebato reZanu PF zvekuti mapurisa haatarisi kuti munhu abva mumba maani kana achiita basa rawo.

title: Muchato waVaTsvangirai naMuzvare Macheka Woenderera Mberi neMugovera
content:
Dare repamusoro rarasa neChitatu chikumbiro chakasvitswa kudare iri naMuzvare Locadia Karimatsenga Tembo chekuti muchato wemutungamiri wehurumende, VaMorgan Tsvangirai, na Muzvare Elizabeth Macheka, uyo uri kuda kuitwa neMugovera, umiswe.

Vachitura mutongo wavo, mutongi wedare repamusoro, Amai Antonia Guvava, vati havawone chikonzero chekuti muchato waVaTsvangirai naMuzvare Macheka usaenderere mberi neMugovera.

Amai Guvava vati pane gakava riripo rekuti Muzvare Karimatsenga Tembo vakaroorwa zvechokwadi here kana kuti kwete naVa Tsvangirai gore rapera. Muzvare Karimatsenga Tembo vanoti vakaroorwa zviri pamurawu wechivanhu, asi Va Tsvangirai vanoti vakabhadhara mari yekuvakanganisa chete, kana kuti damage, mushure mekunge Muzvare Karimatsenga Tembo vaita pamuviri paVaTsvangirai apo pavanoti pakabva pave nemwedzi minomwe nechidimbu.

Kunyange hazvo Muzvare Karimatsenga Tembo vakaunza kudare DVD rezvinonzi zvakaitika pavanoti vakaroorwa naVa Tsvangirai muna Mbudzi gore rapera, Amai Guvava vati havakwanise kushandisa humbowo uhwu sezvo vachiti zvinonetsa kuti dare ritambire DVD iri sehumbowo.

Vatiwo dare ravo harina masimba ekumisa kuroorwa kwemunhu sezvo pane mutemo wakadzikwa unocherechedza mamejasitiriti sevanhu vanobata nyaya idzi.

Amai Guvava vati chitsvambe chave kudare reparamende kuti rivandudze mitemo ine chekuita nekuroorana sezvo vachiti kuroorana kusina kunyoreswa hakucherechedzwe pamutemo.

Mutongi wedare ati Muzvare Karimakatsenga Tembo vane mukana wekuenda kuna mejasitiriti akapa VaTsvangirai mvumo yekuenderera mberi nemuchato wavo kuti vanopa zvikonzero zvingaite kuti muchato uyu umiswe.

Rimwe remagweta aVaTsvangirai, Va Innocent Chagonda, vati muchato wemutungamiri wehurumende uchaenderera mberi neMugovera.

Asi rimwe remagweta aMuzvare Karimatsenga Tembo, Va Everson Samukange, vati vachaenda kudare ramejasitiriti kuti vanokumbira dare iri kuti rikanzure mvumo yarakapa Va Tsvangirai kuitira kuti muchato uyu usaenderere mberi.

Muchato waVaTsvangirai naMuzvare Macheka wakatarisirwa kuitwa pa Raintree ku Umwinsdale muHarare.

Vamwe vevanhu vakakokwa kumuchato uyu vanosanganisira mutungamiri wenyika, VaRobert Mugabe, mutungamiri weBotswana, Va Ian Khama, pamwe nemutungamiri weMalawi, Amai Joice Banda.
summary: Mutongi wedare repamusoro, Amai Antonia Guvava, vati havawone chikonzero chekuti muchato waVaTsvangirai naMuzvare Macheka usaenderere mberi neMugovera.

title: Misoro yeNhau dzaNhasi, Chishanu, Chikunguru 28, 2017
content:
Vatori venhau voratidzira muHarare vachiti mapurisa ari kutyora kodzero dzavo.

Vechidiki veZanu PF mudunhu reMashonaland West vanomanikidza vemabhizinisi kuvhara mangwana vachiti munhu wese anofanirwa kunonzwa mutungamiri wenyika VaRobert Mugabe vachitaura panhandare yemitambo paChinhoyi University of Technology.

Mapurisa nezvikonzi zvedare vanotora midziyo yebato rinopikisa reMDC pamuzinda waro weHarvest House muHarare zvichitevera kutadza kubhadhara chikwereti kwakaitwa nebato iri kune mumwe mushandi waro.

Mapato manomwe anopikisa munyika anosanganisa MDC-T, MDC, PDP, Transform Zimbabwe nemamwe otarisira kuumba mubatanidzwa unonzi MDC Alliance kukwikwidzana neZanu-PF musarudzo dzemuna 2018.

Mubato meZanu-PF moita makakatanwa otyirwa nevamwe kuti anogona kuguma odeura ropa apo nyaya inoti ndiyani achatora chigaro chaVaMugabe younza kunetsana kunotyisa.

Masangano akazvimirira oga anodarika makumi masere nemapfumbamwe oshora hurongwa hwekuvandudza bumbiro remutemo huri kuitwa neZanu-PF.

Munhau dzemitambo, tichakupai zviri kuitika mumitambo yeCastle Premier Soccer League uye kuvhurwa kwenhandare yeRufaro Stadium yange ichigadzirwa.

Muchirongwa cheLiveTalk na8pm tiri kutarisa makakatanwa ari mubato reZanu-PF panyaya yekuti ndiyani achatora chigaro chaVaRobert Mugabe.

Kana muchida kupinda muchirongwa ichi, kanawo kutumira mashoko kuStudio7, shandisai WhatsApp panhamba dzinoti 001 202 465 0318.

Vanoda kuteerera Studio7, tibateyi na7pm pamasaisai anoti 909 am ne 4930 Kilohertz paShortwave mazuva ose.

Musakanganwa kutifarira paFacebook peji redu re VOA Shona.

Kurudzirai hama neshamwari kuti dzitifarire paFacebook yedu.

title: Sarudzo dzeKutsvaga Achamirira MDC muBy-Election kuChegutu Dzinotadza Kubudirira
content:
Sarudzo dzebato reMDC inotungamirirwa naVaNelson Chamisa dzekutsvaga vachamirira bato musarudzo ye by-election ichaitwa muwadhi 2 muChegutu dzakatadza kuenderera mberi neMugovera mushure mekunge dzimwe nhengo dzebato iri dzakapomera vakuru vebato mhosva yekuda kubirira sarudzo iyi kuburikidza nekuda kumanikidza vaikwikwidzana kuti vawirirane asi ivo vasingade.

Vamwe vevanhu vasingadarike zana avo vainge vauya kusarudzo iyi, iyo ichaitwa mwedzi unouya, vakaimba vachiti vaida kuti paitwe sarudzo mushure mekuona kuti mukana wekuitwa kwesarudzo wakanga worambwa nemunyori anoona nezvesarudzo mubato iri, VaJacob Mafume.

VaMafume vakanga vachiti nhengo dzaikwikwidzana dzaifanirwa kungowirirana kuti angamirira bato ndeupi, pane kuti dzipinde musarudzo dzema primary.

Asi VaMafume vakati zvavakaita ndizvo zviri mubumbiro remitemo yebato ravo zvekuti vari kukwikwidzana vanofanirwa kutanga vapihwa mukama wekuti vawirirane pachavo kuti ndiyani ane mukana wekukunda kana kuti consensus.

Patakabvunza VaMafume kuti sei nhengo dzehutungamiri hwebato hwepamusoro kana kuti National Council dzakadzika kuwadhi kuzoitisa sarudzo dzema primary ipo paine hutungamiri hwedunhu guru kana kuti purovhinzi, vakati ivo semunyori mukuru wesarudzo mubato vanogona kuvapo uye panofanirwa kunge paine nhengo yepamusoro yeNational Council pasarudzo dzakaita seiyi.

Imwe nhengo yakapinda mumusangano wekusarudza nhengo ichakwikwidza isina kuda kudomwa nezita yakati vanhu vakanga vauya kusarudzo nekudaro pakanga pasina zvekuti vanhu vawirirane.

Dzimwe nhengo dzakati zvakaitwa hazvisi pamutemo sezvo nhengo dzose dzaifanirwa kuvhota kwete kuti vaifanirwa kuvhota vaite zvekukokwa nehutungamiri.

Imwe nhengo yebato iri iri kunyunyuta ndaVaGift Konjana. VaKonjana vanoti ivo nevamwe vavo vasina kukokwa pamusangano uyu vachasarudza imwe nhengo ichakwikwidzana nemunhu anenge asarudzwa neMDC inotungamirirwa naVaNelson Chamisa.

VaKonjana vanoti munhu avachasarudza achange akamirira MDC - T inotungamirwa naMuzvare Thokozane Khupe, vachiti kusakokwa kwavakaitwa mucherechedzo wekuti vakatorambwa mubato reMDC.

Asi sachigaro weMDC mudunhu reMashonaland West, VaRalph Magunje, vanoti VaKonjani havana kuvharirwa panze asi ivo ndivo vakapanduka.

Vaviri vaifanirwa kupinda musarudzo dzema primary muwadhi 2 ndaVaRydes Machekera naMuzvare Debra Zhanero.

Sarudzo dze by-election dziri kuitwa muwadhi 2 zvichitevera kushaya mwedzi wapera kwaAmai Memory Banda, avo vaive zvakare nhengo yebato reMDC yaVaChamisa.

title: Zvinhu Zvoramba Zvakaipa Muzvipatara zveHurumende
content:
Vanachiremba vanoti havasati vawana zvikwanisiro zvekuti vaende kumabasa avo, kunyange hazvo zvinhu vachiziva kuti hazvina kumira zvakanaka muzvipatara.

Vakafanobata chigaro chemutevedzeri wemutungamiri weZimbabwe Hospital Doctor’s Association, Doctor Masimba Ndoro, vati havasati vapihwa mari inokodzera kunge vachikwanisa kuenda kubasa izvo zviri kuramba zvichiisa hutano hweveruzhinji parumana nzombe.

Dr Ndoro vanoti kunyange hazvo vakaita hurukuro neHealth Services Board, havasati vapiwa mhinduro pazvichemo zvavakaisa.

Dr Ndoro vati pari zvino muzvipatara muri kubatsirwa vane hupenyu huri panjodzi zvakanyanya asiwo vakati vari kukurudzira hurumende kuti igadzirise dambudziko riripo iri vachiti zvinhu hazvina kumira zvakanaka.

Kusamira zvakanaka kuri muzvipatara kwaburitswawo pachena navachiremba vari pasi pesangano reSenior Hospital Doctors Association, avo vazivisawo hurumende kuti vachatanga kuramwa mabasa kutanga nemusi weChina kana hurumende ikasagadzirisa zvichemo zvavo.

Sangano iri rati vashani vemuzvipatara vari kushanda kwemazuva maviri kana matatu pasvondo, asi vana chiremba vadiki vasiri kutoenda kubasa zvachose.

Mugwaro ratumirwa kubazi rezvehutano, pamwe nevakuru vezvipatara, sangano iri rinoti zvinhu zvatoipisisa muzvipatara, nokudaro hurumende inofanirwa kugadzirisa dambudziko iri zvechimbi chimbi.

Pashanyirwa zvipatara zveHarare ne Parirenyatwa, varwere vatadza kuonekwa nana chiremba vange vachiti havachazivi zvokuita.

Mumwe murwere, Amai Monica Chipindu, avo vange vachiti vanorwadziwa zvakanyanya nemusana, vati zvakangovaremera kuuya kuchipatara vodzoswa vasina kurapwa

Vamwe amai zvakare vada kuzivikanwa nezita rekuMagumbo vanga vauya nemwana wavo vaudza Studio 7 kuti kunyange hazvo kumasejari vana chiremba vari kushanda, mari dziri kubhadhariswa varwere havadzikwanisi.

Sachigaro veHealth Services Board, Dr. Paulinas Sikosana, vaudza Studio7 kuti vanachiremba vanofanirwa kudzokera kumabasa sezvo bhodhi ravo riri kugadzirisa mari dzavanotambira.

Vanachiremba vari pasi pesangano reZimbabwe Hospital Doctors Association vakatanga kuramwa basa musi wa Gunyana 3 vachiti havana mari inovakwanira kuti vange vachienda kubasa.

title: Amnesty International Inoti Nyanzvi Ngadziongorore Mapfupa Anonzi ndeeVanhu Vakafa Muhondo
content:
Sangano re Amnesty International rinoti hurumende yeZimbabwe inofanirwa kubvumidza nyanzvi munyaya dzezvekufukunyurwa kwevanhu vakafa kare kare vakavigwa vakawanda panguva imwe chete.

Sangano iri rinoti riri kuona paterevhizheni mitumbi yevanhu nemapfupa avo achiiswa mumabhegi nevanhu vasina kudzidzira basa iri.

Bato reZANU-PF rinoti mitumbi iri kufukunyurwa iyi ndeye vanhu vakafa munguva yehondo yerusununguko. Izvi zvinotevera mitumbi yevanhu vakafukunyurwa mumugodhi usisashandi ku Mt Darwin mudunhu reMashonaland Central.

Pakatanga chirongwa ichi masvondo apfuura, chichikokerwa nesangano re Fallen Heroes Trust, iro rine nhengo dze Zanu PF, hurumende yakamboti yakanga isingazive nezvechirongwa ichi.

Asi svondo rapera, gurukota rezvemukati menyika, Va Kembo Mohadi, vakaudza vatori venhau kuti hurumende yatora chirongwa ichi kubva ku Fallen Heroes Trust, kuitira kuti ivige zvakanaka mapfupa evanhu vanosvika zviuru zviviri, sezvo zvaiva pasi pebazi ravo reNational Museums and Momuments of Zimbabwe.

Mashoko aVaMohadi atsinhirwa nemumwe wavo, Amai Theresa Makone, avo vatiwo chirongwa ichi chava mumaoko ehurumende, chichikokerwa nebazi ravo.

VaSimeon Mawanza vanoshanda sachipanga mazano musangano re Amnesty International. VaMawanza vanoti zvinhu zvakadai zvinoda nyanzvi kuitira kuti pazivikanwe kuti vakafa ava ndevanani.

MDC inotungamirwa naVa Morgan Tsvangirai inoti ZANU-PF inofanirwa kumisa zvairi kuita zvekufukura mapfupa evanhu ichida kuratidza seine hany’a nevanhu asi iyo yakakundikana kuita izvi kwemakore makumi matatu apfuura. Studio7 haina kukwanisa kunzwa divi reZanu PF.

Mutevedzeri wemunyori anoona nezvekuburitswa kweshoko mu MDC-T, Muzvare Thabitha Khumalo, vanoti semaonero avo, vanhu vari kunzi vakafa munguva yehondo yeChimurenga vanogona kuva vari nhengo dzeMDC dzakapondwa muna 2008.

Ukuwo sangano reZIPRA Veterans Trust rinoti rakwidza nyaya yekufukunyurwa kwemapfupa aya mudare repamusoro muBulawayo. Sangano iri rinoda kuti hurumende imise chirongwa ichi munyika yose. Nyaya iyi ichanzwikwa mudare neChina.

Mutevedzeri wemutungamiri we ZIPRA Veterans Trust, Va Baster Magwizi, vanoti sangano ravo rinoda kuti paitwe hurongwa hwakajeka, kwete zviri kuitwa neZanu PF iri muhurumende.
summary: Mapfupa evanhu vanopfuura zviuru zviviri akawanikwa kuMt Darwin
